title: Tourism in Zakopane: A comprehensive guide for the trip with the most important travel tips
content:
Many tourists consider tourism in Zakopane to be part of their escape to nature amid the green hills and mountains, especially after spending their time in the hustle and bustle of the city after tourism in Krakow.
Although Zakopane is called the “Polish winter capital,” its tourist activities are not limited to  Skiing and winter sports, it offers tourists a lot of luxury and enjoyment throughout the year. In the following lines, I will take you on a tour around Zakopane, starting with explaining how to get there, passing through the best places to stay and activities, all the way to the negatives that you may encounter there, so that you can draw a complete picture to plan your next trip to Zakopane. Zakopane is a city located in the south Poland At an altitude of between 800 and 1000 meters at the foot of the majestic Tatra Mountains that form the natural border between Poland and Slovakia. This unique location contributed to shaping its path as a tourist attraction center in Poland and all of Europe, as this small city began attracting tourists since the late eighteenth century, and it still attracts more than 3 million tourists to this day. Most of these tourists head to Zakopane after their trip in Krakow because it is only about an hour and a half away by car. Read also: Tourism in Poland for families: The 7 best tourist places for families Since Zakopane is a small city with no airport you will find several options for getting there depending on your starting point, but the most popular option is to fly via Krakow International Airport as it  is only about 110 kilometers from Zakopane. From there you can take buses, which take 2 to 3 hours per trip, or you can take the train, keeping in mind that it takes longer, but some people prefer the train trip because it passes through the countryside, giving them an additional opportunity to enjoy the stunning scenery. The second solution is to fly to the Polish capital's airport Warsaw It is about 400 kilometers away from Zakopane, which is of course a greater distance, but it remains a practical idea for those who want to visit other cities such as Poznań before arriving in Zakopane. Poland provides you with comprehensive tourism programs. Zakopane gives lovers of nature and adventure an exceptional experience. It is also considered one of the best tourist destinations in Poland for families. Among the most important activities that can be done there are:  Mount Kasprowy is the highest peak in Poland with a height of 1,987 metres. It can be reached via cable car in a 15-minute trip, during which you can see the Tatra Mountains and the border with Slovakia.   You can also visit Gobalowka Mountain, located north of the city, which is one of the most important tourist places in Poland, as it can be reached by mountain train. It is considered a great place to practice hiking in the summer or skiing in the winter. Lake Morskie Oko is considered one of the most beautiful lakes in Poland, especially with the reflection of the mountain in the lake's waters. It can be reached by horse-drawn carriages. But if you are an adventure lover, you can walk to it for a distance of 8 kilometers, starting from the entrance to the Tatra National Park, which includes more than 650 caves and nearly 30 mountain lakes. To get a panoramic picture of the lake's view from above, you can head to the "Charni Stowe" pond at an altitude of 1,583 meters, where you can complete the climb from there to reach the top of the mountain.  This is the main street in the city. It is a long street that extends about 1 kilometer. On its sides there are cafes, restaurants, and shops, and thousands of visitors wander through it in summer and winter. You can taste local foods and grills, as well as biscuits and ice cream, and you can also buy souvenirs such as leather shoes and wool jackets.  It is one of the entertainment attractions and is designed to look upside down Tourism in PolandSo visitors walk on the ceiling instead of the floor, and it is a great place to take photos and experience the effects of gravity in a fun way.
